budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY24 budget was reported as 33% expended in month four, with the FY23 budget still open.
budget_items.quote: the fy23 budget is still open. october is month four and the fy24 budget is 33% expended.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Budget increases were reported in heating charges, office supplies and library materials.
budget_items.quote: some budget increases have been in heating charges, office supplies and library materials.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The CWMARS Network cost was reported as having increased over several years, attributed to town population growth; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the cwmars network cost has increased over the last few years due to the town population increase.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The library was offered restitution after an arrest in the break-in last May.
budget_items.quote: and the library has been offered $1k in restitution.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The director received a quote of $4k to $40k to replace the older cameras and integrate them into the newer system, and a separate quote of $80k to install 24 cameras.
budget_items.quote: he received a quote for $4k - $40k for this. he also received a quote for $80k to install 24 cameras.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The library invested funds balance was reported as $88.9k, described as down a bit.
budget_items.quote: the balance is currently at $88.9k which is down a bit.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The director told Jean Proctor the library will receive ARPA funds for the Memorial Garden; no amount printed.
budget_items.quote: let her know that we will be receiving arpa funds for the memorial garden.
